description: A specified map \(f:M\to N\) is the underlying map of a structure embedding if and only if it preserves the truth of every literal at every finite parameter tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.embedding_iff_preserves_literals.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (f : M → N) :
  (∃ e, ⇑e = f) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.IsLiteral φ →
        ∀ (a : Fin n → M), φ.Realize a → φ.Realize (f ∘ a)
